_meta.status: Step 2 ratified (V15); combat-facing hooks now numeric in COMBAT.md 11
_meta.sources: DESIGN.md v0.4 §2.18/§10/§11 · RACES.md v0.2 mechanical hooks (ratified) · fighter.schema.json example ids
provenance_notes: Trait ids follow the bare snake_case style of the schema example (patient_hunter, et_y_bellum_devout, kier_hardened).

Effects are v0 loose modifier bags in the item.schema.json style. As of COMBAT.md v0.2 (ratified), the 55 combat-facing hooks have numeric conversions in COMBAT.md 11.1; the remainder are explicitly deferred to their own steps in COMBAT.md 11.3. No trait entry in this file changed.

draw: 'pool' traits are rolled from weighted pools by recruitgen; draw: 'special' traits are rolled by their own rules (race rates in races.json, line constants in recruitment.json) and never appear in ordinary pool draws.
rarity → weight mapping lives in recruitment.json. race_weight / origin_weight multiply a trait's base weight for matching fighters.
Everything in this file is (proposed) unless tagged canon in its notes.

Step 5 (PROCUREMENT.md P10): race-locked ITEMS are struck from the design, so `wing_rig_synergy` lost the thermal rig it hooked into and is retired from updraft_ace. The trait is unchanged in effect — `flight_mobility_bonus` already pays the 1.35 -> 1.20 hover exposure. race_locked on TRAITS is untouched.

traits.name: Marksman's Eye
traits.description: Sees the shot before the scope does.

traits.name: Steady Hands
traits.description: The one you want holding the clamp when the shelling starts.

traits.name: Quick Study
traits.description: Learns in one Divide what others need three to absorb.

traits.name: Crowd Darling
traits.description: The cameras find them. They pretend not to notice.

traits.name: Camera-Shy
traits.description: The cameras never learn their name, and they prefer it that way.

traits.name: Scrounger
traits.description: Comes back from a ruined field kitchen with dinner and spare parts.

traits.name: Night Stalker
traits.description: Prefers the hours when the locator flares are stale.

traits.name: Pack Mule
traits.description: Carries their kit, your kit, and the tripod nobody claimed.

traits.name: Gallows Humor
traits.description: The joke lands ten seconds after the shooting stops. Somehow it helps.

traits.name: Grudge Holder
traits.description: Keeps a private ledger. It only has one column.

traits.name: Pact Keeper
traits.description: A deal signed is a deal kept — even when the manager wishes otherwise.

traits.name: Hot-Headed
traits.description: Burns bright, swings hard — both ways.

traits.name: Stoic
traits.description: The needle barely moves. In either direction.

traits.name: Superstitious
traits.description: Has a ritual for the dawn flares and a word against the Aleas' drones.

traits.name: Insomniac
traits.description: Watches the camp perimeter because sleep won't have them.

traits.name: Fast Healer
traits.description: Knits back together like the schedule depends on it.

traits.name: Bleeder
traits.description: Every wound runs one grade worse than it should.

traits.name: Mentor
traits.description: Rookies orbit them. The nerves settle; the habits stick.

traits.name: Born Captain
traits.description: Reads a battlefield the way others read a face.
traits.sim_note: Human captain-aptitude premium (RACES.md, ratified) expressed as draw weight, not a lock.

traits.name: Cool Hand
traits.description: First drop or fiftieth, the breathing never changes.
traits.sim_note: Composure model (rookie nerves vs veteran calm) lands with COMBAT.md.

traits.name: Angle Cutter
traits.description: Crosses between cover like the ground was drawn for them.

traits.name: Shell Counter
traits.description: Hears the tube cough and knows the landing to the meter.

traits.name: Ammo Miser
traits.description: Every round accounted for. The quartermasters send holiday cards.

traits.name: Trigger Itch
traits.description: Shoots at movement, shadows, and once, famously, a flare.

traits.name: Soft Boots
traits.description: Arrives places without the courtesy of being heard first.

traits.name: Eye for Distance
traits.description: Calls yardage without the optics and is rarely off by much.

traits.name: Doorway Nerve
traits.description: Steadiest exactly where the fight gets closest and ugliest.

traits.name: Long Watch
traits.description: Can hold a sightline through a night and a day and stay honest about what crossed it.

traits.name: Field Kitchen
traits.description: Turns forage and ration paste into something a squad lines up for.

traits.name: Jury-Rigger
traits.description: Keeps broken kit lying convincingly about its condition.

traits.name: Map Mind
traits.description: Saw the survey packet once. Navigates it like a home ship corridor.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.description: Has eaten worse than anything this planet grows, and said thank you.

traits.name: Light Sleeper
traits.description: Half-awake is their deepest setting. Ambushers hate it; so do they.

traits.name: Sky Reader
traits.description: Smells the weather turning a watch before the Aleas posts it.

traits.name: Soundbite Machine
traits.description: Everything they say fits a chyron. For better and for worse.

traits.name: Storyline Bait
traits.description: The broadcast keeps finding arcs for them: feuds, redemptions, curses.

traits.name: Logo-Ready
traits.description: Sponsors request them by name. Squadmates have opinions about that.

traits.name: Villain Edit
traits.description: The crowd loves to hate them, and tunes in to do it.

traits.name: Clause Reader
traits.description: Knows their contract, your precedent, and the fleet's going rate to the credit.

traits.name: Loyal to a Fault
traits.description: Will follow the banner anywhere. Including the places it shouldn't go.

traits.name: Union Tongue
traits.description: Knows every grievance in camp and how to say it out loud.

traits.name: Thrill Seeker
traits.description: First hand up for the bad jobs. The medics keep a file open.

traits.name: Second-Guesser
traits.description: Sees every way it could go wrong, and occasionally leaves before it does.

traits.name: Cold Arithmetic
traits.description: Counts the fallen the way others count ammunition. Unshaken. Unwarm.

traits.name: Homesick
traits.description: Carries the ship in their chest. Long Divides wear a hole in it.

traits.name: Slow Starter
traits.description: Terrible first week, every time. Then something clicks shut.

traits.name: Adrenal Surge
traits.description: First contact turns them briefly magnificent. The crash comes due after.

traits.name: White Knuckles
traits.description: Has never dropped a weapon, a stretcher, or a grudge. Not even shot.

traits.name: Aleas' Favorite
traits.description: Zone closures miss them. Drops land beside them. Nobody can prove anything.

traits.name: Bad Omen
traits.description: When things go wrong, the camp remembers who they went wrong near.

traits.name: Kier-Hardened
traits.description: The Bastille taught them exactly how bad it can get. The Divide rarely manages worse.
traits.notes: Canon id — appears in the fighter.schema.json example.

traits.name: Counting the Divides
traits.description: Keeps the clause tally scratched inside their armor. Fights differently as it shrinks.

traits.name: Company Family
traits.description: Third generation on the same ship. The corp's name is practically theirs.

traits.name: Deck-Raised
traits.description: Grew up in these corridors. Fights better beside people who did too.

traits.name: War Debt
traits.description: Owes someone. The someone has bookkeepers, and the bookkeepers have friends.
traits.sim_note: Syndicate/scandal systems land at Step 9; until then this is flavor + salary texture.

traits.name: Odds Watcher
traits.description: Checks the board before breakfast. Plays up when the fleet doubts them.

traits.name: Battle Dancer
traits.description: Carries the dueling forms into the firefight — every reposition a step, every shot a beat.
traits.notes: Ceremonial blades stay ceremonial (canon); the dance is how the discipline shows.

traits.name: Honor-Bound
traits.description: Will not fire on a flag of parley, will not strike a signed partner — whatever the order says.

traits.name: Den Keeper
traits.description: Wherever they bed down becomes, briefly, somewhere worth defending.

traits.name: Quartermaster's Knack
traits.description: Two bodies, four hands, one flawless inventory.

traits.name: Tether-Trained
traits.description: Years of drills stretched the link further than the physicians thought wise.
traits.sim_note: Extends races.json tether_miles.trained; hard numbers with COMBAT.md.

traits.name: Smothering Fire
traits.description: Doesn't aim at you so much as at everywhere you might be.

traits.name: Walking Bulwark
traits.description: The squad advances behind them the way infantry once advanced behind vehicles.

traits.name: War-Born
traits.description: Has seen everything a battlefield can do to a body. Registers none of it.

traits.name: Few Words
traits.description: Has spoken on broadcast twice. Both clips are famous.

traits.name: Updraft Ace
traits.description: Reads thermals the way others read terrain. The sky is cover too.

traits.name: Rank Climber
traits.description: Every roster posting is read twice: once for the squad, once for their own name's position in it.
traits.notes: Amplifies the canon status coupling in both directions.

traits.name: Brittle Wings
traits.description: One bad landing away from a grounded season.
traits.sim_note: Wing injury table owed by COMBAT.md.

traits.name: Pride Bearer
traits.description: Carries the pride name like a standard; squadmates straighten when they pass.

traits.name: Tradition Keeper
traits.description: Signed for a banner, not a mood. Mid-stream cleverness is met with granite patience.
traits.notes: Ratified vibe from RACES.md — resents mid-Divide policy whiplash.

traits.name: Cull-Tempered
traits.description: Survived the training years. Panic was culled out with the weak.

traits.name: War-Priest
traits.description: Tends wounds and doubts alike. Every bandage a blessing of Et-y-Bellum.

traits.name: Battle Augur
traits.description: Reads omens in flare patterns and drone drift — and is right unsettlingly often.

traits.name: Et-y-Bellum Devout
traits.description: Holds the faith openly: battle is the sacrament their people were made for.
traits.notes: Canon id (schema example). Rolled per races.json devotion_lines, not the pool. Cede friction is the ratified spicier variant.

traits.name: Et-y-Bellum Zealot
traits.description: The sacrament is everything. Evacuation is apostasy; a quiet death, heresy.
traits.notes: Zealots take the Et- honorific (ratified). Rolled per races.json devotion_lines.

traits.name: Battle-Joy
traits.description: Grins wider as the fight gets worse. Steadies, where others shake.
traits.notes: The disciplined rendering of the withdrawn frenzy idea (ratified).

traits.name: Mimic Call
traits.description: Can throw a rival captain's voice fifty meters into the wrong ravine.
traits.notes: From the canon naming lore — vocal mimics produced in youth.

traits.name: Broadcast Savage
traits.description: Fights like the cameras are the audience they were born for. The cameras agree.

traits.name: Patient Hunter
traits.description: Will hold a sightline for a day and a night, and call the wait pleasant.
traits.notes: Canon id — appears in the fighter.schema.json example.

traits.name: Ambush Instinct
traits.description: The first volley is theirs. It usually decides the rest.

traits.name: Goggle Tinkerer
traits.description: Never stops adjusting the optics — theirs, yours, the squad's, the drone they caught.

traits.name: Psion: Battle-Sense
traits.description: Feels the shot a heartbeat before the trigger. Moves first.
traits.notes: Psionics scope per RACES.md: rare line, one expression per psion. Rolled per races.json psionics rates.

traits.name: Psion: Squad-Link
traits.description: A whisper of the Mon-Wa gift: the squad simply knows where they are.

traits.name: Psion: Pressure-Read
traits.description: Sits in on negotiations. Tells you, afterward, which offers were bluffs.
traits.notes: The manager-facing expression — feeds the Step 6 negotiation engine.

traits.name: Cradleborn Resentment
traits.description: Serves the fleet that spent their homeworld, and never once forgets it did.
traits.notes: Canon thread (DESIGN.md §2.18, §3.3). Never rolls on humans — the Spent Cradles are not theirs to mourn. Rates per races.json resentment_rate.

traits.name: Ankoth Sympathizer
traits.description: Has read the pamphlets. Privately thinks the banished had a point about the Divide.
traits.notes: Quiet undercurrent per §3.5 — any race, humans included; far likelier alongside cradleborn_resentment. Rates in recruitment.json. Scandal system lands at Step 9.

traits.name: Keshu Grudge
traits.description: The War for Keshu ended fifty-five years ago. Some households never signed the peace.
traits.notes: Ratified spice from RACES.md — friction with the other Keshu race, or the long road to an unlikely friendship. Rates in recruitment.json.
